author: YoMushi
quote: They either need to change the protagonists or completely rethink the storyline. This feels way too restrictive compared to GTA V, which offered far more freedom, flexibility, and entertaining features. GTA has always been about player choice, chaos, and freedom, not being constrained by the protagonists’ relationship or what feels like forced woke feminism. If these changes are true, Rockstar has lost sight of what made GTA great in the first place. This completely ruin the game.
